Name: Cypher's Barns and Coops
Author: Genomecypher
Description:
Still learning about modding and this is my second attempt. This mod is intended to match the style for the mod I made for the SVE Premium barn and coop. For now the only color options are red for the barns and red and green for the coops.

I plan to add the ability to change color at Robin's in a future update. I love copper roofs which is what made me create a farm buildings mod in the first place but there is an option to select between a copper metal roof and a dark green shingle roof.

The barns and coops are seasonal and have seasonal specific accents. There is an option to turn off the cherry blossom petals in spring and the fall leaves in fall. Each barn and coop retexture can be turned on separately. The big barn and deluxe barn have windows that can be customized on a season-by-season basis. By default, the windows are partially open for spring, fully opened for summer, half opened for fall, and closed for winter.

Hope you enjoy!
